stem: An analyst computes a promotion's baseline by averaging weekly units only over the weeks that have rows in the sales table. Two of the 4 baseline weeks had no sales at all. Compared with Voltmarkt's convention, what does this do to the reported uplift?

options.text: Nothing changes, because weeks with no sales add no units to the sum
The baseline comes out too low, so the uplift is overstated
The baseline comes out too high, so the uplift is understated
The uplift turns into a measure of revenue rather than volume
